title: RedLine Stealer: 441.7K accounts breached
summary: In December 2021, logs from the RedLine Stealer malware were left publicly exposed and were then obtained by security researcher Bob Diachenko. The data included 441 thousand unique email addresses, usernames and plain text passwords.

title: Protemps: 49.6K accounts breached
summary: In October 2021, the Singaporean recruitment website Protemps suffered a data breach that exposed almost 50,000 unique email addresses. title: Gravatar: 114M accounts breached
summary: In October 2020, a security researcher published a technique for scraping large volumes of data from Gravatar, the service for providing globally unique avatars . 167 million names, usernames and MD5 hashes of email addresses used to reference users' avatars were subsequently scraped and distributed
